newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues urgent anti-drought measures.
newsitem.headline: China issues urgent anti-drought measures.

text.p: China's State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and the Ministry of Water Resources issued an urgent notice on Thursday calling for drought relief measures in many parts of the country.

Since the beginning of June, many regions north of the Yangtze river have been plagued by high temperatures and little rainfall, while record high temperatures hit northern China and western parts of northeast China, the Xinhua news agency said.
The drought has caused damage to about 17.3 million hectares of crops, 5.8 million hectares of which were hit by severe drought, the notice said.
In late June most parts of north China will have less rainfall and the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze river will suffer from a summer drought, it said.
China said this week it estimated the summer grain harvest at a record 118 tonnes, up by 3.5 percent compared with last year.
China reported a record harvest of 490 million tonnes last year and has said it hopes to repeat that in 1997.
